evidence_semantics: Provider positive idle/empty queue and unchanged log/QoS prefixes anchor a complete coverage window. It is not an admission barrier; subsequent work must be reconciled by complete drain logs, QoS and journal after old-process exit.
Successful final provider check-in is mandatory before reservoir signal. Journal advancement alone is insufficient because it precedes the swallowing push call.

Final inventory is reconciled through complete lifecycle/final-batch logs. Every final active handle must have a fresh top-level NPZ and thermostat sidecar in the stopped inventory; historical/quarantined files remain included.

Large logs are hashed in fixed-prefix streaming chunks at most 1 MiB. Appends after captured prefix are allowed; inode change, truncation, prefix rewrite and incomplete tails refuse. Only bounded captured tails may be loaded by semantic parsers.

Actual private restored state and all startup per-handle entity/backend/tick/mode lines must agree without restore/thermostat warnings. This is deterministic-path inference from exact stopped inputs and implementation, not direct live byte equality.
No forced stop, no live-worker bootout, no automatic repeated override/signal/replay, and no state rollback. Unknown outcomes retain guards and evidence for explicit reviewed recovery.
limitations: A per-handle synchronous snapshot can still block the event loop; the repair yields between handles only.
Existing launchd holder check/control calls have an unavoidable narrow OS race; exact ownership guards and retained failure evidence remain mandatory.
Historical loaded Python/model bytes are not retroactively proven by present disk hashes; recorded deployment lineage is explicitly reviewed inference.

preparation_contract.hash_projection: preparation_digest excludes only execution_review to avoid a circular review hash; runtime_alignment and other input references remain bound
preparation_contract.identity: Exact fixed provider/reservoir labels, PID/start/argv/listener, current host boot and uid, pause actor/generation/no lease; seven protected process identities
preparation_contract.interpreter_binding: Canonical SHA256 of the full interpreter_files map, not a single launcher digest
preparation_contract.originals: Separate owned nofollow hash-bound original source and plist copies for both roles; equal canonical bytes before first operation
preparation_contract.provenance: Complete validated original model manifest, package RECORD content verification, actual interpreter family, immutable model snapshot, all canonical root Python sources matching preserved source closure, reviewed runtime-alignment inference
preparation_contract.restart: provider_restart_argv is observed process argv with only its one --model value pinned. provider_restart_plist preserves the original launch alias, every other argument and all plist keys; canonical installed plist is atomically replaced after accepted reservoir startup
preparation_contract.restore: Six exact source files: cooperative scheduler repair entrypoint plus five unchanged dependencies; original venv Python, complete installed package metadata/RECORD, pyvenv, and full interpreter map; configuration derived from exact original reservoir argv/defaults

required_before_any_production_drain: Fresh passing host-memory gate before actual numerical qualification.
